purpose: Extra worldwide research map for Arabic/Islamic digital humanities, OCR/HTR, ASR, diacritization, scholarly corpora, Quran/Hadith resources and public funding. Research references never become runtime dependencies or automatic content imports.

highValueResearchSources.name: OpenITI Corpus
highValueResearchSources.value: Open-access machine-actionable Arabic/Persian corpus; current work scales OCR-derived texts and metadata enrichment.

highValueResearchSources.name: OpenITI MAKHZAN
highValueResearchSources.value: Open annotated Arabic, Persian, Ottoman Turkish and Urdu print/manuscript data for OCR/HTR.

highValueResearchSources.name: TariMa
highValueResearchSources.value: Ground truth for OCR/HTR of Maghrebi Arabic documents; especially relevant to North African material.

highValueResearchSources.name: MAS
highValueResearchSources.value: Line-level historical Arabic manuscript OCR benchmark spanning Naskh, Taliq and Nastaliq.

highValueResearchSources.name: KITAB-Bench
highValueResearchSources.value: Arabic OCR/document benchmark covering printed/handwritten recognition, layout, tables and PDF-to-text.

highValueResearchSources.name: Mozilla Common Voice Arabic 26.0
highValueResearchSources.rights: CC0_1_0; redistribution restrictions apply to dataset packaging
highValueResearchSources.value: Large current Arabic read-speech resource for ASR evaluation/training; must not be re-hosted when prohibited by current terms.

highValueResearchSources.name: ArabicSpeech
highValueResearchSources.value: Community hub with multiple Arabic speech datasets including ArA-DF and regional resources.

highValueResearchSources.name: Shakkelha
highValueResearchSources.value: Arabic text diacritization models, datasets and comparative evaluation.

highValueResearchSources.name: Rawi/text2tashkeel
highValueResearchSources.rights: Apache_2_0_code; verify each bundled model credit/license
highValueResearchSources.value: Offline ONNX Arabic diacritization with published DER/latency figures.

highValueResearchSources.name: Canonical Islamic Corpus
highValueResearchSources.value: Current 2026 corpus combining Quran and hadith material for evaluation; use as a provenance lead, not authoritative replacement.

highValueResearchSources.name: Quranic Arabic Corpus
highValueResearchSources.value: Morphological/syntactic annotation; changes to distributed annotation are restricted by its stated terms.

highValueResearchSources.name: Tanzil Quran Text
highValueResearchSources.value: Highly verified Quran text; may be used in applications with attribution/link while preserving the text unchanged.

highValueResearchSources.name: Quran Foundation APIs
highValueResearchSources.value: Useful API integration path, but raw QF content may not be redistributed; do not make it a paid/core dependency.

funding_and_partnership_targets.name: NLnet Foundation
funding_and_partnership_targets.notes: Free/open outputs are transversal requirements; strong fit for open OCR/search/security infrastructure.

funding_and_partnership_targets.name: Makiya-Kufa Gallery Annual Grants
funding_and_partnership_targets.notes: Advances public understanding of Arab Islamic culture; reports and acknowledgment required.

funding_and_partnership_targets.name: Modern Endangered Archives Program (UCLA/Arcadia)
funding_and_partnership_targets.notes: Best for endangered collections/documentation/digitization; funded materials are published open access.

funding_and_partnership_targets.name: Endangered Archives Programme
funding_and_partnership_targets.window: annual cycle typically opens September and closes November
funding_and_partnership_targets.notes: Strong heritage digitization route when a concrete endangered archival collection and eligible custodial partner exist.

funding_and_partnership_targets.name: Horizon Europe Cluster 2 - Cultural Heritage
funding_and_partnership_targets.notes: Potential fit for open cultural-heritage digitization and trustworthy AI through eligible consortium routes.

funding_and_partnership_targets.name: Makiya-Kufa / Arab Islamic culture ecosystem
funding_and_partnership_targets.notes: Particularly relevant because the grant explicitly targets public understanding of Arab Islamic culture.

doNotImportAutomatically: Quran Foundation raw API data when redistribution is prohibited
Common Voice Arabic archives where current terms prohibit re-sharing
model weights with non-commercial restrictions into a commercial path
any funding-conditioned proprietary service into the core runtime
